basic_info.description: Located in an elegant corner building in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods, 2155 Buchanan #6 boasts exquisite architectural detail, classic elegance and tremendous light throughout. The floor plan includes an inviting living room with oversized windows and beautiful ceiling trim, formal large-scale dining room, two spacious bedrooms and bathroom with marble countertops, double sinks and shower over tub. Bright updated kitchen with butler's pantry, ample cabinet space and stainless steel appliances (including brand new refrigerator).     Additional amenities include: 1 car parking space (private entrance with electric garage door), elevator, hardwood floors, a pet-friendly HOA, free laundry in the building, and a serene and lush shared yard.     Seismically upgraded in 2018.  Very close to many shops and restaurants along Fillmore Street, public transportation and the iconic Lafayette Park just one block away.
